project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components frontend
build_system: Electron Forge - no compilation step needed, plain JS loaded via script tags
test_framework: None - no automated tests exist yet
build_command: npm install (no build step beyond dependency install)
test_command: No test suite available - validate by running npx prettier --check src/
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to ensure deps resolve. 2. Run npx prettier --check src/ to validate formatting. 3. Manually verify no syntax errors with node -e "require('./src/utils/window.js')" and node -e "require('./src/storage.js')"
environment_constraints: Electron app - cannot run npm start without display. Use AST validation (require checks) for main process files. Renderer files use ES module imports and cannot be required directly.
contribution_requirements: Run npx prettier --write . before committing. Prettier uses 4-space indent, 150 print width, semicolons, single quotes.
key_patterns: Main process: CommonJS require/module.exports. Renderer: ES modules with Lit web components. IPC communication between main/renderer via ipcMain.handle/ipcRenderer.invoke. Window state persisted via storage.js JSON files. Theme system uses CSS custom properties on document.documentElement.
directory_structure: src/index.js (main process entry), src/utils/window.js (window creation + hotkeys), src/utils/renderer.js (renderer process globals + theme + toasts), src/components/views/ (Lit web component views), src/storage.js (JSON file-based persistence)
